activity_summary: In the shop the windfalls were sorted, fourteen of them, three soft for the pig. The skins on the bench were six pairs of sheep, and the order had been kid. Richard said you would walk them back yourself, after the frame, because the writing was yours. You set Wednesday for the walk. You did not leave the house. Hamnet was not allowed to mend the word, or to come and count the six.
